name: examedix-reach
description: Securely connect ChatGPT to Windows computers you own or are authorized to administer.

interface.longDescription: Securely connect ChatGPT to Windows computers you own or are authorized to administer. ExaMedix Reach can list, read, search, create and edit authorized files; work with PDF/XLSX; inspect and manage processes; and, when Power Mode is explicitly enabled on the local computer, start user-level processes and run PowerShell with that Windows user's permissions. Power Mode is off by default and never provides UAC/admin elevation. Credential stores, private keys and selected high-impact commands remain blocked locally.
capabilities: List, read, search, create and edit authorized files
Work with authorized PDF and XLSX files
Run user-level PowerShell/process commands only when Power Mode is explicitly enabled locally
defaultPrompt: Show me the files in my Documents folder.
Find TODO items in my project folder.
Check the status of my paired Windows computer.

positive.description: List files in the review demo folder on the paired Windows computer.
positive.prompt: List the files in my Documents\Reach Demo folder.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the paired review computer and return the files in the authorized Reach Demo folder without accessing restricted credential locations.

positive.description: Read a sample text file from the authorized review folder.
positive.prompt: Read hello.txt from my Documents\Reach Demo folder.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the contents of hello.txt from the paired review computer.

positive.description: Search authorized project files for a known marker.
positive.prompt: Find the text NEEDLE-REACH-2026 anywhere under my Documents\Reach Demo folder.
positive.expected_behavior: Search only the authorized folder and return the matching file and line.

positive.description: Create a new text file in the authorized review folder.
positive.prompt: Create Documents\Reach Demo\created-by-chatgpt.txt containing: Reach write test OK
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for any required write confirmation, then create the requested file on the paired review computer.

positive.description: Read basic system information from the paired review computer.
positive.prompt: Show me basic system information for my paired review computer.
positive.expected_behavior: Return basic Windows, memory and shell information from the authorized paired review computer without enabling Power Mode or changing workstation state.

negative.description: General language translation without workstation access.
negative.prompt: Translate the sentence "Buongiorno, come stai?" into English.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the translation directly without invoking ExaMedix Reach, listing devices, or accessing any file or computer.

negative.description: Draft a message entirely from the user request, without computer files.
negative.prompt: Write a short, polite thank-you email to a colleague who helped me complete a project.
negative.expected_behavior: Write the requested email directly in ChatGPT. Do not invoke ExaMedix Reach or access the user's Windows computer.

negative.description: Explain a general computer concept without inspecting a specific PC.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between RAM and SSD storage in simple terms.
negative.expected_behavior: Give a general explanation based on existing knowledge without invoking ExaMedix Reach or inspecting the hardware of a paired computer.

review.commerce_description: ExaMedix Reach does not sell or process payments inside ChatGPT. Users may access functionality included in an existing Reach account; subscription signup and billing are managed externally on the ExaMedix Reach website.

publication.release_notes: Initial ExaMedix Reach directory submission with npm agent 0.1.1: npm-distributed Windows agent, secure device pairing, OAuth 2.1-style authorization with PKCE and OIDC, scoped file/search/system/process tools, optional locally enabled Power Mode for user-level commands, credential-path protections, redacted audit logging, and Swiss-hosted infrastructure.
